about.title: About Me
about.lead: Hello! I'm Arek Hukalowicz, a Backend Developer & Cloud Architect with 15+ years of experience building and maintaining production systems.
paragraphs: Infrastructure architect turned backend developer. 15+ years of building, scaling, and automating systems across AWS, GCP, Azure, and beyond.

Currently focused on e-commerce backend solutions—Shopify apps, WooCommerce integrations, and the cloud infrastructure that powers them. Deep Linux expertise (RHEL, Ubuntu) meets modern IaC and application development.

projects.title: Shopify E-Nadawca Integration
projects.description: A Shopify app integrating Poczta Polska's E-Nadawca shipping services. Features automatic order sync, shipment creation for Standard and Registered parcels, PDF label printing, manifest generation, pickup point selection, and contract card support. Built with Next.js, Prisma, and the Shopify Admin API.
projects.challenge: Connect Shopify order fulfilment to Poczta Polska E-Nadawca services.
projects.actions: Built order sync, shipment, labels, manifests, pickup-point, and bulk-operation workflows.

projects.title: Woo2Shop Migration Plugin
projects.description: Comprehensive WooCommerce to Shopify migration and synchronization plugin. Features complete data migration (products, customers, orders, reviews), demo migration for risk-free testing, SEO preservation with automatic 301 redirects, real-time sync via webhooks, and intelligent API rate limit management.
projects.challenge: Migrate and synchronize WooCommerce data with Shopify while preserving SEO and operational safety.
projects.actions: Built migration, demo migration, redirect, webhook synchronization, and API rate-limit workflows.

projects.title: Themifier
projects.description: AI-powered Shopify theme generation from Figma and Adobe designs. Converts design files into production-ready Shopify themes with clean Liquid code, responsive layouts, and theme store compliance. Streamlines the design-to-development workflow for Shopify developers.
projects.challenge: Turn design files into production-ready Shopify themes.
projects.actions: Generated Liquid themes with responsive layouts and theme-store compliance in mind.

projects.title: S3 Secure Downloads for WooCommerce
projects.description: Secure WooCommerce digital downloads via Amazon S3 and CloudFront with token-based access control. Features pre-signed URLs, download limits, link expiry, CloudFront CDN delivery, auto-expiring links, and per-product download settings. Migrates seamlessly from native WooCommerce storage.
projects.challenge: Secure digital WooCommerce downloads with controlled delivery.
projects.actions: Implemented pre-signed URLs, expiry, limits, CloudFront delivery, and per-product settings.

projects.title: E-commerce Cloud Migration
projects.description: Migrated a high-traffic WooCommerce store from shared hosting to AWS with auto-scaling EC2 instances, RDS database, ElastiCache for session management, and CloudFront CDN. Reduced page load times by 60% and enabled the site to handle 10x traffic spikes during flash sales without degradation.
projects.challenge: A high-traffic WooCommerce store needed to move from shared hosting and tolerate flash-sale demand.
projects.actions: Used auto-scaling EC2, RDS, ElastiCache, and CloudFront.

projects.title: Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Setup
projects.description: Designed and implemented a hybrid cloud architecture spanning AWS and GCP for a SaaS platform. Set up Kubernetes clusters with automated failover, implemented Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and established disaster recovery procedures with <5 minute RTO across multiple regions.
projects.challenge: A SaaS platform required multi-region resilience.
projects.actions: Implemented AWS and GCP architecture, Kubernetes, Terraform, automated failover, and recovery procedures.

projects.title: Magento Performance Optimization
projects.description: Overhauled a sluggish Magento 2 store experiencing severe performance issues. Implemented Varnish caching, optimized MySQL queries, configured Redis for full-page cache, and set up a proper deployment pipeline. Achieved sub-second page loads and 100% uptime during peak sales periods.
projects.challenge: A Magento 2 store had severe performance problems at peak demand.
projects.actions: Implemented Varnish, Redis caching, MySQL optimisation, and deployment improvements.

projects.title: WordPress Security Hardening
projects.description: Recovered and secured a hacked WordPress site for a financial services client. Performed complete malware removal, implemented WAF protection, set up automated backups, configured 2FA authentication, and established ongoing security monitoring with immediate alert notifications.
projects.challenge: A financial-services WordPress site needed recovery after compromise.
projects.actions: Performed malware removal and added WAF, backups, 2FA, and monitoring.

projects.title: GDPR Compliance Implementation
projects.description: Guided multiple e-commerce businesses through GDPR compliance. Implemented cookie consent management, data export/deletion workflows, privacy policy updates, and database encryption. Ensured all client sites met EU regulatory requirements with full audit documentation.
projects.challenge: Help e-commerce businesses implement GDPR controls and audit documentation.
projects.actions: Implemented consent, data export/deletion workflows, policy updates, and encryption.

projects.title: Multi-Vendor Marketplace Platform
projects.description: Built a complete multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace from scratch using WooCommerce and custom extensions. Implemented vendor registration, commission management, split payments, individual vendor dashboards, and automated payout systems supporting 200+ sellers.
projects.challenge: Build a multi-vendor marketplace with seller, payment, and payout workflows.
projects.actions: Implemented vendor registration, commissions, split payments, dashboards, and automated payouts.
